entities.name: SSC mode
entities.description: Information element indicating the session and service continuity mode requested by the UE when establishing a new PDU session with a data network.

entities.name: PDU session establishment
entities.description: Procedure where the UE requests to establish a new PDU session with a data network.

entities.name: PDU session establishment request message
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request establishment of a new PDU session.

relations.description: The PDU session establishment request message includes the SSC mode IE when the UE requests to establish a new PDU session with a DN and requests an SSC mode.
The PDU session establishment procedure includes sending the PDU session establishment request message.
